housing.text: She said California must build multiple kinds of housing and cited laws she authored to ease construction of starter and affordable homes.
housing.quote: California has to build more housing — apartments, starter homes, shelter beds, supportive housing and multifamily housing — while respecting the character of existing communities.

safety.text: She helped obtain additional funding for San Diego County firefighters and law enforcement.
safety.quote: She has helped secure new funding for San Diego County firefighters and law enforcement.

abortion.text: Boerner co-authored Proposition 1 to enshrine abortion rights and contraception in the California Constitution.
abortion.quote: I co-authored Proposition 1 , which would enshrine reproductive rights in the California Constitution. Proposition 1 is an essential step to protect the right to abortion health care and birth control

health.text: She introduced legislation to preserve Medi-Cal enrollment and called for expanding preventive, primary and mental-health care.
health.quote: I introduced AB 2201, the Protecting Medi-Cal Coverage for Californians Act, to streamline Medi-Cal eligibility and reduce wrongful terminations. We should also expand prevention, primary care and mental health treatment, because it makes good moral and fiscal sense.

energy.text: She committed to a renewable-energy transition and advocated investments in clean-energy production and climate-resilience infrastructure.
energy.quote: I am committed to transitioning to renewable energy and ensuring cleaner air and water for future generations.

tax.text: Hannaway condemned proposed tax increases as harmful to working Californians.
tax.quote: Whether it’s skyrocketing taxes, burdensome regulations, or outright attacks on personal freedoms, these bills are not just misguided—they are a direct assault on the rights, wallets, and futures of hardworking Californians.
